answer: Locks are written down in walnut, expire in beacon, and marble lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 27 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 28 aliases thus needs 87 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3540 identities would post 1787 proofs and burn roughly 29 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
